newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to push for law to end budget "holes" - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain to push for law to end budget "holes" - Rato.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato told Congress on Tuesday that the government would present a bill to make impossible further budget "holes", a measure destined to completely restore market confidence.
In July, the fledgling conservative government said it had discovered a 721 billion peseta gap in the 1995 accounts that it had inherited from the former Socialist government.
"We will present a bill that will make it impossible for a situation such as the one we are now facing to ever reoccur," Rato said.
"These are grave, crucial situations - but by no means unique in Spanish budgetary history," Rato said.
Rato said this measure, coupled with the necessary financing to cover the budget hole, was necessary to restore market confidence.
